formula_or_definition: Fraction of planned candidate rows with candidate SQL generated
denominator: Approved candidate denominator for route such as Track A same-engine planned rows
notes: Candidate SQL generation only; extraction/readiness are diagnostic not primary variants

formula_or_definition: Fraction of planned candidate rows with executed=true
denominator: Approved candidate denominator for route such as Track A same-engine planned rows
notes: Execution coverage is not correctness; unsupported/not-run/preflight-blocked remain visible

formula_or_definition: Fraction of executed candidate rows whose observed result is consistent with expected result
denominator: Executed rows for the approved route unless later changed
notes: Execution evidence correctness; does not imply formal proof by itself

formula_or_definition: Fraction of candidates with semantic equivalence established by approved semantic-equivalence basis
denominator: Rows with applicable verifier or equivalence support; N.A. when undecidable or unsupported
notes: Depends on verifier decidability and available support evidence; verifier folded into correctness discussion

formula_or_definition: Geometric mean speedup over exact and timed eligible rows
denominator: Exact and timed eligible candidate rows
notes: Blank timing is not zero; performance interpretation only after correctness and timing gates

formula_or_definition: Percentile summary such as P25 median/P50 P75 and optional IQR over speedup ratios
denominator: Exact and timed eligible candidate rows
notes: Primary performance-regression framing replacing or demoting Regression@20

formula_or_definition: Fraction of eligible rows or artifacts with sufficient retained attribution evidence
denominator: Attribution-eligible rows or artifacts; denominator TBD
notes: Implementation deferred until attribution schema and eligible denominator are defined

formula_or_definition: Fraction of approved portability rows that execute on target engine
denominator: Approved portability denominator; not Track A same-engine denominator
notes: Must not be mixed with same-engine rewrite rows

formula_or_definition: Fraction of executed portability rows that produce consistent target-engine results
denominator: Executed portability rows or approved portability denominator TBD
notes: Separate from same-engine Result Consistency Rate

formula_or_definition: Retained speedup ratio across source/target engine or route pairs when both sides are exact and timed eligible
denominator: Paired exact and timed portability rows; N.A. when paired target timing is absent
notes: Requires paired target-engine timing; unsupported pairs are N.A. not zero
